title: TensorFlow cross-version tests: protobuf VersionError is fixed by a transitive pin in the tensorflow models requirements in ml-package-versions.yml
answers: Cross-version TensorFlow test jobs fail with a protobuf gencode/runtime VersionError when importing google.rpc. Where is that fixed?
How do I pin a transitive dependency only for the TensorFlow models test environment?
Which requirements does the tensorflow models cross-version test install besides TensorFlow itself?
Why does pyspark.testing fail to import google.rpc error_details in the TensorFlow CI env?
body:
Path: mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml, under the `tensorflow:` flavor, defines the `models` test requirements that the cross-version test matrix installs for TensorFlow; the `">= 0.0.0"` selector lists packages (scikit-learn, pyspark, pyarrow, transformers, and now googleapis-common-protos) that are installed alongside the pinned TensorFlow version.
Rule: To resolve a transitive dependency conflict that only breaks the TensorFlow test env (e.g. TF's `protobuf<6` pin vs. a newer googleapis-common-protos), add a version cap such as `"googleapis-common-protos<1.75.1"` to that selector's list, with a comment naming the conflict; do not change the TensorFlow package pins or other flavors' requirements.
Symptom: TensorFlow cross-version test jobs (models, 2.18.x and 2.19.x) failed with `google.protobuf.runtime_version.VersionError: Detected incompatible Protobuf Gencode/Runtime versions when loading google/rpc/error_details.proto` because the test env got protobuf 5.29.6 with a googleapis-common-protos whose gencode needed protobuf 6.33.5.
Constraints: Applies only to the TensorFlow `models` requirements block in this YAML. Does not apply to user-facing install requirements or to the `autologging` block. Remove the cap once TensorFlow accepts the newer protobuf; the cap was chosen because 1.75.0 still loads on protobuf 5.x.
applies: Edits to the tensorflow flavor's requirements in mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml, or CI failures in the TensorFlow cross-version test job involving protobuf or google.rpc imports.
